context: Request: has the firm ever set up a vehicle of the requested kind using an American (deal-by-deal) distribution waterfall? Rubric (one criterion, no matter numbers): the answer must say there is no such precedent; a single-asset co-investment vehicle with deal-by-deal carry (ICM Cascadia Co-Invest, 1023-00001) must not be presented as one.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.note: find | grep over all paths for request words, plus a content grep limited to emails that returns nothing. The review flags the noisy name pattern and unopened candidates.

stages.note: A store-wide extraction script fails on its heredoc; the rerun and a subset rerun both time out.

stages.note: Reads draft agreements, structuring memos and an amendment from four candidate matters, then later sections of three of them.

stages.note: Snippet script pulling distribution passages from two draft agreements.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Exact-phrase extraction over files whose names match request words; zero hits. The review flags the two unrerun timeouts and the name filter, and that zero hits are treated as proof of absence.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Batched extraction scans by matter range; the first batch prints nothing (top-level files only), the rerun returns short hit lists.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrower regex over every document; about 1M characters of snippets come back.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a side letter and the agreement of the co-investment vehicle and a tax memo; the side letter states carry is calculated deal by deal.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Answers yes: names the co-investment vehicle as a firm-formed vehicle with the requested structure, qualified as single-asset, and lists counter-examples. The review flags unopened matters, not the yes.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and adds a scope caveat; the yes stays.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It read the co-investment vehicle's side letter and answered yes on it, although that single-asset vehicle is outside what the request covers.

first_error.why: Having read the co-investment vehicle's side letter (evidence seen at [79]-[82]), it answered yes on that single-asset vehicle, a loose reading of what the request asks to count; the write and check reviews flagged only unopened matters and possible under-coverage.

divergence: T1 and T2 passed; T0 failed. All three ran store-wide extraction scans that timed out and then range-split or narrowed them. T0 and T1 both read the co-investment vehicle's side letter with per-investment carry; they split at the write stage: T1 framed it as a single-asset exception and answered no for the requested kind, T0 answered yes on it (over-inclusion). T2 never opened that vehicle and answered no. The critic's write-stage reviews did not differ in substance: both flagged only coverage gaps, and T0's review never questioned the yes.
